facts.text: The hotel sits atop Taipei City Hall station, next to Taipei 101 and Taipei Dome.
facts.excerpt: Perched atop Taipei City Hall station next to iconic Taipei 101 and Taipei Dome.

facts.text: The hotel's address is 10 Zhongxiao East Road Sec. 5, Xinyi District, Taipei.
facts.excerpt: 10 Zhongxiao East Road Sec. 5, Xinyi District, Taipei, Taiwan

facts.text: The hotel is perched above the Uni department store and the City Hall MRT stop, minutes from Taipei 101.

facts.text: WOOBAR is on the 10th floor with a view of Taipei 101.
